text:
anya: Quick heads-up — Detroit DevCon is 4 weeks out. Need final booth kit list, speaker coverage, swag order, and lead-routing plan by EOD Fri. Can we assign owners? TL;DR: swag + demo hardware + speaker handoffs + CRM mapping.
jamal: I can own speaker liaison & schedule. I'll sync with the speakers and post the confirmed slots tomorrow. @anya remind me about A/V needs.
sylvie: Swag: initial qty proposal: 250 tees, 300 stickers, 150 notebooks, 100 hoodies. Link to draft order doc: https://rdw.co/docs/detroit-swag-draft (please add sizes).
priya: I'll own inbound lead routing and QR card design. Plan: 2 QR codes — one for demo signups (Sales SDR queue), one for product updates (Marketing drip).
events-bot: Event created: Detroit DevCon — Booth B12. Date: 2025-05-12, 08:00-18:00. Calendar invites sent to listed assignees.
jamal: Speaker coverage update: we have 3 accepted talks (30m each). Need two booth reps during talk times: 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30, 15:30-16:00. I'll assign rotations in a Google Sheet.
anya: Packaging & courier: who can handle condensed packing list + courier pickup window? We need insured courier for 1 pallet. Also confirm booth toolkit: zip ties, gaffer, power strip, HDMI adapter.
ops: We have confirmed 20A outlet at Booth B12 and a 6ft table. No tablecloth provided. Courier pickup ok on 5/11 afternoon; need exact pallet dims.
devex: Demo hardware: I'll bring 2 laptops and 1 Jetson edge box. Can someone verify we have 2 spare HDMI adapters and a small UPS? Also need test accounts preloaded.
sylvie: Hoodie sizes — please add in the swag doc. Also propose adding 150 branded face masks and 200 hand-sanitizer bottles (small). Budget check: hoodies + masks bump cost ~ $1.6k.
priya: CRM mapping snippet for SDR queue (for ops/devs):
```
source: detroit_devcon
form: demo_signup
route_to: sales_sdr_queue@redwood
priority: high
metadata: [event:detroit_devcon, speaker:linked]
```
This will create a lead record and assign to SDR rota.
anya: Love that. Jamal — can you confirm booth reps for the talk slots by EOD tomorrow? Ops — please confirm courier pickup formalities (address + pickup window). Sylvie — finalize sizes and place swag order by Friday cutoff. Priya — will you QA QR landing pages?
jamal: Confirming I'll post rotation sheet tonight and ping reps.
ops: Courier confirmed — pickup 5/11 between 2-4pm. Address: 712 Industrial Ave, Concord Logistics. Please pack pallet with protective wrap.
sylvie: Swag order placed (PO# RDW-5843). ETA to warehouse 5/9. Hoodie sizes sent to fulfillment.
priya: QR pages ready for quick QA — staging links posted in the doc. I'll run through flows tonight and share checklist.
anya: Perfect. Last ask — can everyone drop a thumbs-up in this thread once their piece is locked? Will compile a final one-pager for the leadership weekly update.
